name: codex-naming-studio
description: A native Codex naming workbench widget for collecting baby naming constraints, asking Codex to run the naming analysis, and rendering structured results back into the GUI.

interface.shortDescription: Collect naming constraints and let Codex return structured name analysis.
interface.longDescription: Codex Naming Studio opens a native Codex widget where users fill baby naming constraints, submit them to Codex, wait in the GUI, and receive ranked Chinese name candidates with scoring, five-elements analysis, source notes, and comparison cards.
defaultPrompt: Open the Codex Naming Studio workbench for this project.
Handle the pending Naming Studio request and write results back to the GUI.
